purpose: Adversarially audit only the frozen validated Codex result, waiver-aware comparison and synthesis plan without acquiring new research facts.
post_audit_holds: Claude and Grok absence remains visible and confidence remains medium.
The aggregate owns sustainability disclosure revisions while entity, observation, dataset, statement, filing, assurance, risk, plan, action, incident and records masters remain external.
The WM-ECO-033 parent signal and every neighboring edge remain provisional rather than canonical.
ISSB, ESRS and GRI users, materiality lenses, scopes and legal effects remain distinct.
Impact, dependency, risk, opportunity, metric, observation, calculation, estimate, scenario, target and assurance conclusion remain separate assertion types.
Organizational, operational, value-chain, GHG, metric and assurance boundaries remain explicit and independently versioned.
Prepared, reviewed, approved, assured, filed, published, regulator-reviewed, compliant, restated and final states do not prove one another.
Every external projection remains framework-scoped, release-pinned and loss-declaring.
audit_findings: The aggregate preserves stable disclosure and immutable revision identities while external masters retain authority.
Framework-specific applicability, materiality, content, assurance and legal effects remain explicitly scoped.
Reported values preserve metric definition, unit, dimension, boundary, method, source, period, uncertainty and provenance.
Missing data is not zero, estimates are not observations, targets are not outcomes and scenarios are not forecasts by default.
Management approval, assurance, filing, publication and regulator review remain separate authority and lifecycle planes.
Restatements and withdrawals preserve published predecessors and the original assurance scope.
Autonomous materiality, approval, assurance, filing, publication, validation waiver, protected-data disclosure and destruction remain prohibited.
No unresolved critical semantic conflict prevents reviewable-draft publication.
